method: Read primary publication / author-hosted arXiv pages through web lookup; no secondary summaries used as technical evidence.
scope: Only the specific claims listed here were checked; not a claim to independently reproduce or review every result in the cited papers.
experiment_evidence: All course experiment numbers are generated by experiment.py and saved in outputs; cited paper performance values are not used as course results.

sources.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
sources.checked_material: PMLR publication page and original paper PDF, method section / pseudocode
sources.verified_claim: Image/text encoders use normalized embeddings, scaled pairwise similarity, and symmetric cross entropy.
sources.course_use: Dual-encoder objective background; original small NumPy implementation, not the pretrained model or full-scale experiment.

sources.title: Debiased Contrastive Learning
sources.verified_claim: Randomly sampled negatives can share semantic labels; the paper proposes a debiased objective.
sources.course_use: False-negative problem background only; course does not implement the paper estimator.

sources.title: Supervised Contrastive Learning
sources.verified_claim: Supervised batch contrastive learning uses label information to bring same-class points together.
sources.course_use: Multi-positive supervision background; course-specific cross-modal target is explicitly defined in code.
